description.value: Shanghai Dumpling King is an authentic Shanghai pot sticker restaurant in Richmond specializing in Huaiyang-style dumplings with thin wrappers, crisp bottoms, and abundant juices. The owner hand-grinds the meat and hand-rolls the wrappers, blending traditional Shanghai pot sticker technique with northeastern Chinese dumpling influences. Cyclists passing through Richmond's Westminster Highway corridor can order online for quick pick-up.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 20m; rack at 75m; rack at 83m; rack at 90m. Total: 4 spaces.
